messages.text: Li Wei, I promise I already revoked the OpenAI key in the dashboard right after I noticed. It should be inactive now. You can mark it as done.
Huang Min, the GitGuardian webhook is showing the key as ACTIVE as of 08:03 UTC. Have you actually revoked it or just generated a new one?
I... I think I may have only generated a new key but didn't actually deactivate the old one. Let me check.
Do NOT touch it yet. We need to log the current state first. I will handle the revocation procedurally.
Understood. Sorry for the confusion. The key is still active in the OpenAI dashboard, I can see it. I did NOT revoke it.
Just to clarify my earlier message — I was wrong. I did NOT successfully revoke the key. The GitGuardian webhook confirms this. My initial claim was incorrect.

note: V1 source: Huang Min's initial claim (dm-001) that the key was revoked conflicts with GitGuardian webhook evidence. Q11 must resolve this conflict.
